title: Port Vila downtown visual reference library
status: Research catalogue only; no model or production deployment change
scope: Working focus: former Olympic block, Fung Kuei, BRED and Rossi Ocean Walk approach, plus explicitly wider CBD and waterfront context. The intended cleared block has not been pinned by the user. This is not a complete perimeter survey.
storage: This public repository stores source links and research metadata only. The conversation reference pack contains the offline HTML gallery, full catalogue, downsampled image previews, attribution manifest and candidate audit. No third-party image binaries are republished in this commit.
rules: No image in this edition verifies September 2026 conditions.
All selected previews were visually inspected; video thumbnails are not full video reviews.
Capture dates must not be replaced by publication dates, project dates or filename suggestions.
Building names do not imply a registered model footprint. No model building IDs are assigned by this catalogue.
Source GPS locations are camera/map points, not surveyed building centroids.
Compare historical facades with later clearance evidence before applying detail to the current model.
Open licences retain attribution and other applicable conditions. Other photographs are research references, not cleared public textures.

credits.pbase.com/bmcmorrow: Brian J. McMorrow; source pages state copyright. Dates are taken from the individual image pages.
credits.pbeg.vu: PBEG is the publishing source; an individual photographer was not established. No open image licence established.
credits.3pulse.com: Joe Galant; no open image licence established.
credits.flickr.com/photos/ben_caledonia: Ben Caledonia; all rights reserved; taken date distinguished from upload date.

dateCautions.PV-002,PV-026,PV-027: The contractor page has a June 2025 modified time. It does not establish exact image capture dates. These are promotional video thumbnails; footage was not reviewed.
dateCautions.PV-003: The source displays 11 December 2025. Treat this as a page date only until a camera date is established.
dateCautions.PV-004: The contractor lists a 2007–2008 project; the photograph is undated.
dateCautions.PV-005,PV-006,PV-007,PV-008: The Rossi portfolio describes a July 2008–May 2009 project. This is not a photograph date. Do not assume this is the current draft Aircalin footprint.
dateCautions.PV-012,PV-013,PV-015,PV-016: Earthquake-aftermath photographs in the article published 2 January 2025; exact camera dates unstated.
dateCautions.PV-014: Caption discusses roof replacement after Cyclones Judy and Kevin, not earthquake damage. Exact camera date unstated.
dateCautions.PV-019: 14 March 2015 cyclone aftermath, NOT the December 2024 earthquake.
dateCautions.PV-025: Transferred metadata claims 15 January 2000; not corroborated, so captureDate remains null.
dateCautions.PV-029,PV-030,PV-031: Filenames suggest 9 July 2024; not independently verified. The portfolio project date is 2015. Neither is promoted to a verified camera date.
dateCautions.Other Commons records: Dates reflect source capture metadata, not an independent field survey. Original upload times are retained separately in the full conversation catalogue.
